ElementAttributeMethods<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, ElementClassListMethods<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, ElementConsumerMethods<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, ElementContainerMethods<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, ElementEventMethods<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, ElementIdMethods<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, ElementQueryMethods<HTMLDivElement>, HTMLElementAttributeMethods<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, HTMLElementDataMethods<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, HTMLElementStyleMethods<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, HTMLElementVisibilityMethods<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, IsElement<HTMLDivElement>, TypedBuilder<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, Component, HasValue<Double>, OuiaSupport<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, Modifiers.Disabled<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>
public class NumberInput extends BaseComponent<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput> implements Modifiers.Disabled<HTMLDivElement, NumberInput>, HasValue<Double>
A number input combines a text input field with buttons to provide users with a quick and effective way to enter and modify a numeric value.
